keyframes.instruction: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, arms hanging relaxed.
keyframes.key_points: Weight even on both feet. Eyes and head level with the horizon. Breathe gently.
keyframes.mistakes: Locking the knees; hunched shoulders.

keyframes.instruction: Raise your hands, your wrists and biceps follow the hands.
keyframes.key_points: Maintain your posture. Weight distribution stays the same
keyframes.mistakes: Locking the knees; hunched shoulders.

keyframes.instruction: Lower your hands, your wrists and biceps follow the hands.
keyframes.key_points: Maintain your posture. Weight distribution stays the same
keyframes.mistakes: Locking the knees; hunched shoulders.

keyframes.instruction: Move your hands to the right as you pivot right on your left foot. Imagine you start to hold a ball, your left hand supporting the bottom and your right hand supporting the top.
keyframes.key_points: Maintain your posture. Weight should be mostly on the left. Arms should be curved.
keyframes.mistakes: Hands too close together. Right should be around pelvis level and left at heart level.

keyframes.instruction: Shift your weight to the right. Your right hand, palm down, comes down to your hips and your left hand, palm up, rises up to heart level. Step up with your left foot and shift your weight to your left.
keyframes.key_points: Weight should be mostly on your left. Arms should be curved. Right hand at hips and left hand at heart level.
keyframes.mistakes: Hands in the wrong place (too high, too low, too far back), feet not wide enough apart

keyframes.instruction: Both hands turn over as you turn clockwise, pivoting on your left foot. Right foot steps in as your pivot right.
keyframes.key_points: Maintain your posture and your left side holds most of the weight here

keyframes.instruction: Step forward with your right foot and your shift forward, your hands extending outward to the northeast corner. Left palm down, right palm up.
keyframes.key_points: Make sure you are facing northeast relative to where you started (starting direction is north).

keyframes.instruction: Hands come back to your waist as your right hand turns over.
keyframes.key_points: Your weight shifts left as your hands move back.

keyframes.instruction: After your hands come back, move your hands towards your chest while pressing your palms together
keyframes.key_points: Pressing your palms together is very important.
keyframes.mistakes: Hands aren't together

keyframes.instruction: Push forwards with your hands still pressed together
keyframes.key_points: Press forward with your hands while shifting your weight forwards.
keyframes.mistakes: Pushes in the wrong direction. Should be pushing eastward relative to your starting direction.

keyframes.instruction: Separate your hands, making sure your palms are turned downwards and keeping them at shoulder level. Keep your hands extended. Pivot counterclockwise until you are facing west
keyframes.key_points: Keep your arms extended and your palms down.

keyframes.sub_name: Right hand forms a downward beak shape
keyframes.instruction: Pivot clockwise until your right hand extends north. Direct your right hand's fingers towards the ground.
keyframes.key_points: Your right hand, just behind your shoulder, should look like a peacock's beak.

keyframes.instruction: Left hand, bladed, extends west
keyframes.key_points: Lead with your hand's pisaform.
keyframes.mistakes: Make sure your right arm is slightly behind the shoulder

keyframes.instruction: Start lowering your hands as you pivot clockwise on your left foot, your wrists and biceps follow the hands.
keyframes.key_points: Maintain your posture and balance as you move.

keyframes.sub_name: Hands come back up, right foot now in front
keyframes.instruction: Align your right hand so that it is angled away from you at chest level. Move your left towards your heart. Your right foot steps forward.
keyframes.key_points: Your heels should be between each other, on the same line. Your right heel should be directly in front of your left.
keyframes.mistakes: Fingers straight

keyframes.instruction: Left hand moves by your right shoulder as if you're striking something with your right shoulder. Right hand moves down. Pivot counterclockwise so that you're facing west.
keyframes.key_points: Most of your weight should be on the right foot. Pretend that you're blocking someone's strike with your left hand and hitting something with your right shoulder.

keyframes.sub_name: Right hand above head, left hand by hip
keyframes.instruction: Raise your right hand above your head, and lower your left hand so that it is by your left hip
keyframes.key_points: Most of your weight should be on the right foot. Your left foot should barely be touching the ground; only the ball of your foot should be in contact. You should be in an empty stance
keyframes.mistakes: If you feel off balance, shift a bit of weight on to your front foot.

keyframes.instruction: Right hand comes down and across to the left
keyframes.key_points: Keep most of your weight on the right foot.

keyframes.sub_name: Left hand goes up, comes down, and right hand brushes right knee simultaneously
keyframes.instruction: Left hand goes up, comes down, and right hand brushes right knee simultaneously while the left hand comes down
keyframes.key_points: Keep most of your weight on the right foot.

keyframes.sub_name: Left Brush Knee and right hand moves by right ear. Left foot steps up
keyframes.instruction: Left hand brushes knee and right hand moves by right ear. Shift more of your weight on your left foot.Your left palm should be just in front of your left hip.
keyframes.key_points: You should now be in a bow stance.
keyframes.mistakes: Left palm too far back; right hand too high or low

keyframes.instruction: Step up with right foot while your left hand starts to rise to neck level and your right hand to chest level

keyframes.sub_name: Hands come up while stepping up with left foot
keyframes.instruction: Hands come up while stepping up with left foot, such that your left hand is higher than your right.
keyframes.key_points: Fingers should be pointing diagnoally upwards. Left foot in front of right. Your right heel should be touching the ground while your right heel is off the ground.
keyframes.mistakes: Too much weight on front foot

keyframes.sub_name: Left hand brushes knee and right hand moves by right ear and extends forward
keyframes.instruction: Left hand brushes knee and right hand moves by right ear and extends forward. Shift your weight to your left foot.
keyframes.key_points: Keep the key points from the previous left brush knee in mind.

keyframes.instruction: Left foot pivots counterclockwise
keyframes.key_points: Keep most of your weight on the left foot. The right brush knee is very similar to the left brush knee except it is on the other side.

keyframes.sub_name: Left hand moves back to left ear while right foot steps up and right hand brushes right knee
keyframes.instruction: Left hand moves back to left ear while right foot steps up and right hand brushes right knee
keyframes.key_points: Keep most of your weight on the left foot.
keyframes.mistakes: Stepping too far. If you feel like you need to really reach forward or lower yourself to step, you're overdoing it.

keyframes.sub_name: Left hand extends outwards while right foot steps up again
keyframes.instruction: Left hand extends outwards while right foot steps up again
keyframes.key_points: You should now be in a bow stance.
keyframes.mistakes: Right palm too far back; left hand too high or low

keyframes.instruction: Right foot pivots counterclockwise
keyframes.key_points: Keep most of your weight on the right foot.

keyframes.sub_name: Right hand moves back to right ear while left foot steps up and left hand brushes left knee
keyframes.instruction: Right hand moves back to right ear while left foot steps up and left hand brushes left knee
keyframes.key_points: Keep most of your weight on the right foot.
keyframes.mistakes: Stepping too far. If you feel like you need to really reach forward or lower yourself to step, you're overdoing it.

keyframes.sub_name: Right hand extends outwards while left foot steps up again
keyframes.instruction: Right hand extends outwards while left foot steps up again
keyframes.key_points: You should now be in a bow stance.
keyframes.mistakes: Left palm too far back; right hand too high or low

keyframes.instruction: Step up with right foot

keyframes.sub_name: Hands come up while stepping up with left foot
keyframes.instruction: Hands come up while stepping up with left foot, such that your left hand is higher than your right.
keyframes.key_points: Fingers should be pointing forwards. Left foot in front of right. Your right heel should be touching the ground while your right heel is off the ground.
keyframes.mistakes: Too much weight on front foot

keyframes.sub_name: Left Brush Knee and right hand moves by right ear
keyframes.instruction: Left hand brushes knee and right hand moves by right ear and extends forward. Shift your weight to your left foot.
keyframes.key_points: Keep the key points from the previous left brush knee in mind.
keyframes.mistakes: Left palm too far back; right hand too high or low

keyframes.movement_name: Twist, Deflect, Step, Parry and Punch
keyframes.sub_name: Left foot pivots counterclockwise, hands shift left
keyframes.instruction: Left foot pivots counterclockwise, hands shift left
keyframes.key_points: Your weight gradually shifts forward to the left foot after it has pivoted.

keyframes.movement_name: Twist, Deflect, Step, Parry and Punch
keyframes.sub_name: Right foot kicks the ground, left hand brushes left knee
keyframes.instruction: Right foot kicks the ground, as your right hand moves down and inward
keyframes.key_points: Most of your weight should be on the the left.

keyframes.movement_name: Twist, Deflect, Step, Parry and Punch
keyframes.instruction: Left hand blocks at heart level, right foot steps up, and right hand forms a fist while moving towards your right side
keyframes.key_points: You are blocking an attack with your left hand by brushing it away.

keyframes.movement_name: Twist, Deflect, Step, Parry and Punch
keyframes.sub_name: Right hand punches, right foot steps up
keyframes.instruction: Right hand punches, left foot steps up
keyframes.key_points: The punch is a counter to that attack.
keyframes.mistakes: All movements not combined together. This is a complex set of actions

keyframes.sub_name: Right hand moves back and left hand brushes bottom of wrist
keyframes.instruction: Right hand moves back and left hand brushes bottom of wrist
keyframes.key_points: Almost like you're wiping something off of the bottom of your right wrist

keyframes.instruction: Both hands push forwards.
keyframes.key_points: Express your energy with your palms
keyframes.mistakes: Not pushing in front of you.

keyframes.sub_name: Both hands turn 90 degrees and both feet turn roughly 90 degrees
keyframes.instruction: Both hands turn 90 degrees and both feet turn roughly 90 degrees, your right foot going first
keyframes.mistakes: Not facing forwards, the direction you started with.

keyframes.instruction: Hands come down and then raise up, your forearms crossing.
keyframes.key_points: Your left forearm is in front of your right.
keyframes.mistakes: Left forearm behind the right forearm

keyframes.sub_name: Hands go to the side and then go down
keyframes.instruction: Palms rotate downward as your hands go to the side and then go down.
keyframes.key_points: You should end up in the beginning position.
